R-001.threat: Sender repudiation: {{sourceName}} denies sending the request or data
R-001.cause: No non-repudiation mechanism on the data flow — requests from {{sourceName}} are not signed or cryptographically bound to the sender
R-001.attack: {{sourceName}} claims it never sent the command or data that {{targetName}} received and acted upon

R-002.threat: Receiver repudiation: {{targetName}} denies receiving or processing the request
R-002.cause: No delivery confirmation or cryptographic receipt — {{sourceName}} has no proof that {{targetName}} received its data
R-002.attack: {{targetName}} claims it never received the data from {{sourceName}}, or denies having processed it
